# SBOM fixtures of existing tools

The SBOMs of the small projects in `sample/` (2026-11-12) and `sample-maven/` (2026-11-14), and of Debian images
(2026-11-19, 2026-11-20), generated by the tools that `forewarn` users run, and read by `../real_tools.rs`. They are kept as the
tools wrote them, saved as compact JSON (one line), except `trivy.cdx.json` and `cdxgen-debian.cdx.json`, trimmed (below). Regenerate them only on
purpose: the tests assert their exact components.

| File | Tool | Spec version | Command, from `sample/` unless said otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cargo-cyclonedx.cdx.json` | `cargo-cyclonedx` 0.5.10 | 1.6 | `cargo cyclonedx --format json --spec-version 1.6 --override-filename bom`, then `bom.json` compacted |
| `syft.cdx.json` | `syft` 1.57.1 | 1.6 | `docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src:ro anchore/syft:v1.57.1 scan dir:/src --source-name rollcall-fixture-sample --source-version 0.1.0 -o cyclonedx-json@1.6` |
| `cdxgen.cdx.json` | `cdxgen` 13.2.0 | 1.7 | `docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app:ro --entrypoint sh ghcr.io/cyclonedx/cdxgen:13.2.0 -c 'cdxgen -t rust -r /app -o /tmp/bom.json --spec-version 1.7 >/dev/null && cat /tmp/bom.json'` |
| `cdxgen-maven.cdx.json` | `cdxgen` 13.2.0 | 1.7 | from `sample-maven/`: `docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app:ro --entrypoint sh ghcr.io/cyclonedx/cdxgen:13.2.0 -c 'cdxgen -t java -r /app -o /tmp/bom.json --spec-version 1.7 >/dev/null && cat /tmp/bom.json'`, generated on 2026-11-14 |
| `trivy.cdx.json` | `trivy` 0.76.2 | 1.7 | `docker run --rm aquasec/trivy@sha256:8f6bb947dbc528902e11f2f5be52f7b519f6a39d5d148f41166f2040499768fb image --quiet --scanners license --format cyclonedx debian:bookworm-slim` (image index `sha256:734a72b3d6142a71993b4bc580ca01d8ca687f77a2c422d96a961d3376b179bc`), then trimmed with `jq -c 'del(.dependencies) \| .components \|= map(select(.type == "operating-system" or (.name \| IN("bash", "libc6", "login", "libpam0g", "libapt-pkg6.0"))))'` |
| `cdxgen-debian.cdx.json` | `cdxgen` 13.2.0 (its Trivy plugin v0.74.0) | 1.7 | `docker save debian:12 -o debian12.tar` (image index `sha256:268fb24c39bca92d326dd83ea3abebe4a3f7751c804ffef23bb6d857dd343ff8`), then from its directory `docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/data:ro --entrypoint sh ghcr.io/cyclonedx/cdxgen:13.2.0 -c 'cdxgen -t docker /data/debian12.tar -o /tmp/bom.json --spec-version 1.7 >/dev/null 2>&1 && cat /tmp/bom.json'`, then trimmed with `jq -c 'del(.dependencies) \| .components \|= map(select((.purl // "" \| startswith("pkg:deb/")) and (.name \| IN("passwd", "login", "libc6", "util-linux", "libblkid1", "shadow", "glibc"))))'` |

`trivy.cdx.json` keeps 5 of the 88 `deb` packages of the image (the whole SBOM is 206 KB), chosen for their source
package: the same name (`bash`, a binNMU), another name (`libc6` of `glibc`, `libpam0g` of `pam`), an epoch (`login`
of `shadow`) and no Debian revision (`libapt-pkg6.0` of `apt`).

`cdxgen-debian.cdx.json` keeps 7 of the 2,280 components (130 `deb` packages, the whole SBOM is 2 MB): the binary
packages `passwd`, `login` (of `shadow`), `libc6` (of `glibc`), `libblkid1` and `util-linux` (of `util-linux`), and the
components cdxgen adds for the source packages `shadow` and `glibc`, tagged `source`; it adds none for `util-linux`,
a binary of the same package URL.

`sample-maven/` is a Maven project of two modules, `mod-a` and `mod-b`, which `cdxgen` nests under
`metadata.component` and nowhere else; it is never built either.

`sample/` is its own Cargo workspace root, outside the `forewarn` workspace; it is never built. Its package keeps the
name `rollcall-fixture-sample`, from before the product was renamed, because the SBOMs above record it.
